column6: round 46 C2 / M46-1 (instrument-drift): the release-clock gate's DEFAULT offline replay, run from the ledger so a held gate cannot sit red unnoticed. It read FAILED on every committed tip from 4776f71 (round 39) to BASE f597728 and no round re-ran it, because the round-36 migration of R25-04 replaced the only default-replay row with a byte pin of the round-26 receipt; R25-04 keeps its byte pin and this row restores the live reading beside it. Red witness at BASE: the same command exits 1 and prints FAILED (on_release=29 bound=28 unbound=1 observed=28 fired=13 derived=15) — measured in a git-archive copy of f597728, never the lane tree; at the candidate it must read CLEAN with all 29 on-release clocks bound and observed. fired/derived stay [0-9]+ because S098's new clock may fire or derive. `-B` is omitted deliberately: the command policy refuses an option before the script word (POLICY python-script). Appending this row also moves two membership pins (measured in the same scratch copy): R21-04 86 -> 87 and R24-14 ledger-ids count=87 sha256=e7a97e968d685a7a023ac37a66c116a02f2a6718628e2351b47df9f022e69940, and re-stamping corpus/stamps.tsv moves R24-05.
